# Quantive

> Quantive StrategyAI is an AI-powered strategy management and execution platform that helps organizations align goals, track OKRs, and drive strategic agility.

Quantive (acquired by WorkBoard) provides comprehensive strategy management software with AI capabilities, including strategic planning, execution, and evaluation tools. The platform serves executives, strategy leaders, and organizations of all sizes with OKR tracking, goal alignment, and business transformation features.

## Key Topics

- OKR (Objectives and Key Results)
- Strategy Management
- AI-Powered Strategy
- Strategic Planning
- Strategy Execution
- Goal Tracking
- KPI Tracking
- Team Alignment
- Strategic Agility
- Business Transformation
- Change Management
- Viva Goals Migration
- Decision Maps
- Collaboration Tools
- Enterprise Strategy

## Core Products

- [AI-Powered Strategy Management Software | Quantive StrategyAI](https://quantive.com/products/strategyai): Quantive StrategyAI: AI-powered strategy management and OKR software.
- [AI-Powered Strategic Planning for Modern Businesses | Quantive](https://quantive.com/products/strategic-planning): Quantive StrategyAI: AI-powered strategic planning with Decision Maps.
- [AI-Powered Strategy Execution for Modern Businesses | Quantive](https://quantive.com/products/strategy-execution): Quantive StrategyAI: Strategy execution, OKR tracking, and team alignment.
- [AI-Powered Strategy Evaluation for Modern Businesses | Quantive](https://quantive.com/products/strategy-evaluation): Quantive StrategyAI: Strategy evaluation with dashboards and metrics.
